title: Judgment rows
description: AD-21's import contract: what a command or sealed-brief-agent evaluator answers for one trial. The runtime converts the rows into a SealedRunRecord's findings, oracle dispositions and judge results through evaluator/mapping.json alone, and adds to this schema, per evaluation, that each row's key is one the mapping declares and appears at most once. Quotes and citations reach eval-quality score exactly as stated: the runtime checks nothing eval-quality's ingest checks. The tea-evaluate runtime owns this schema.

rows.description: One row per mapped key the evaluator judged in this trial.

recommendation.description: The evaluator's own recommendation for the trial, recorded for every probe the trial judges. When absent, a probe's is FAIL when the rows filed a finding against it and PASS otherwise; a trial set records the most severe across its trials, since eval-quality holds the recommendation equal across a set.

outcome.description: pass: the bound oracle held. fail: it was violated, which files a defect finding. score: a score for the bound rubric criterion.

score.description: The criterion's score, one of the levels its binding restates; required on a score row and absent otherwise.

observationIds.description: The trial's observations the judgment rests on, as the runtime identified them to the evaluator.

quote.description: Text quoted verbatim from a cited observation's channel; required on a fail row.

quoteChannel.description: The channel the quote comes from, in eval-quality's quotation vocabulary; required on a fail row.

artifactId.description: The written file the quote comes from: required when quoteChannel is artifact, and absent on every other channel.

confidence.description: The evaluator's confidence in the row, from 0 to 1; required on a fail row, whose finding carries it.

comment.description: What the evaluator found, in one or more sentences; required on a fail row, whose finding carries it as its summary.
